config.source: SELECT hospital_name, SUM(total_tests) AS total_tests FROM adb_dev_healthcare.gold.hospital_daily_summary GROUP BY hospital_name ORDER BY total_tests DESC LIMIT 10

dimensions.name: age_group
dimensions.expr:
CASE
  WHEN age <= 17 THEN '0-17'
  WHEN age <= 30 THEN '18-30'
  WHEN age <= 45 THEN '31-45'
  WHEN age <= 60 THEN '46-60'
  WHEN age <= 75 THEN '61-75'
  ELSE '76+'
END

measures.name: patients_with_abnormal
measures.expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN abnormal_test_count >= 1 THEN patient_id END)

config.source: SELECT insurance_provider_name, COUNT(patient_id) AS patient_count FROM adb_dev_healthcare.gold.patient_360 GROUP BY insurance_provider_name ORDER BY patient_count DESC LIMIT 10

datasets.name: top20_high_risk
queryLines:
SELECT
  patient_id,
  first_name,
  last_name,
  age,
  gender,
  hospital_name,
  total_tests,
  abnormal_test_count,
  critical_test_count
FROM
  adb_dev_healthcare.gold.patient_360
ORDER BY
  critical_test_count DESC,
  abnormal_test_count DESC
LIMIT 20

config.source: SELECT hospital_name, SUM(active_doctor_count) AS active_doctors FROM adb_dev_healthcare.gold.hospital_daily_summary GROUP BY hospital_name ORDER BY active_doctors DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT hospital_name, AVG(abnormal_rate_pct) AS avg_abnormal_rate FROM adb_dev_healthcare.gold.hospital_daily_summary GROUP BY hospital_name ORDER BY avg_abnormal_rate DESC LIMIT 15

SELECT test_name, abnormal_rate_change_pct FROM adb_dev_healthcare.gold.lab_test_trends WHERE year = (SELECT MAX(year) FROM adb_dev_healthcare.gold.lab_test_trends)
  AND month = (SELECT MAX(month) FROM adb_dev_healthcare.gold.lab_test_trends WHERE year = (SELECT MAX(year) FROM adb_dev_healthcare.gold.lab_test_trends))
